summary: Stakeholder map follows the Deloitte Excel template: one row per stakeholder with influence/interest analysis and engagement strategy. Ground every row in the brief, WBS, or RAID; limit inferred stakeholders to 3–5 with rationale.

columns.description: Required when source is inferred; empty when explicit
e.g. Manage Closely, Keep Informed, Keep Satisfied

generation_rules: Root JSON: {"stakeholders": [ /* one object per table row */ ]}.
source must be explicit or inferred (lowercase in JSON).
rationale is required and non-empty when source is inferred; null or empty when explicit.
influence_level and interest_level: High, Medium, or Low.
communication_frequency: Weekly, Bi-weekly, Monthly, or Ad-hoc.
Do not invent generic roles without WBS/RAID/brief justification.

example_rows.name: Deloitte Client Representatives
example_rows.role_in_project: Provide project expectations, evaluation criteria, and feedback
example_rows.key_concerns: Quality of outputs, professionalism, usefulness of agent
example_rows.engagement_approach: Progress reviews, milestone sign-offs, feedback sessions

example_rows.name: Project Team Lead
example_rows.role_in_project: Oversees coordination, deadlines, and team integration
example_rows.key_concerns: Timeline management, team alignment, project completion
example_rows.engagement_approach: Team coordination, issue resolution, task tracking

example_rows.name: AI Developers
example_rows.rationale: AI agent development is required to build and implement the proposed solution
example_rows.role_in_project: Build and implement the AI agent and revision loop
example_rows.engagement_approach: Technical reviews, sprint planning, testing discussions

example_rows.name: Stakeholder Management Analyst
example_rows.role_in_project: Designs stakeholder mapping template and stakeholder logic
example_rows.key_concerns: Accuracy of stakeholder identification and communication structure
example_rows.engagement_approach: Stakeholder review sessions and feedback incorporation

example_rows.name: RAID Analyst
example_rows.rationale: Risk identification and management are required deliverables within the project scope
example_rows.role_in_project: Develops RAID framework and risk identification structure
example_rows.key_concerns: Completeness of risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans
example_rows.engagement_approach: Risk review discussions and coordination with workstream leads

example_rows.name: QA / Testing Members
example_rows.role_in_project: Test outputs, identify errors, and validate deliverables
example_rows.key_concerns: Reliability, consistency, and usability of outputs
example_rows.engagement_approach: Testing reviews, issue reporting, validation feedback

example_rows.name: End Users / Evaluators
example_rows.role_in_project: Review and evaluate final project deliverables

example_rows.name: Course Instructors / TAs
example_rows.role_in_project: Assess project quality and assignment requirements
